records.opening_text: Per-share economics improved on the reported EPS measure over the available history. Basic EPS increased from ₹15.70 per share in FY20 to ₹47.80 per share in FY26 (CAGR ~20.4% per year). FY23 was a major inflection year.
records.detailed_explanation_summary: Per-share analysis asks whether business progress is accruing to each owner or being diluted. The 7-year series allows a longitudinal reading rather than a single-year snapshot. EPS and owner earnings per share can diverge when capex intensity changes, making both series necessary for a complete view.
